$Comment: The feast's Wild Turkeys (the role Harvest_Feast_Turkey). Martha's favor's Kills table (ZiggfreedCommon/Reputations/SeasonsOfOrbis/Harvest_Feast_Host.json) pays favor for each one put down. No reputation group names this group, so it changes nothing about how they treat a player. A turkey once tamed takes the game's own tame turkey role, which is not in this group, so it pays no favor. Add a role id here, written *<id>, and its kills count too. The game's own grown turkey pays less, through its own group (Harvest_Feast_Game_Turkeys) and Kills row. Each of this pack's role ids is written after a * the way the game's own groups write *Chicken: the star still matches that role (and only it: the Turkey Souls and the Great Turkey do not end in Harvest_Feast_Turkey), while the game works a group out again as each mod's roles load, before this pack's own, so a bare id would log a warning at every server start though the group comes out the same.
